root_cause_and_reachability.original: owned_lane.lsof_pids constructed -nP -w -t and treated empty stderr as an error-free query. Apple -t itself suppresses warnings, so native selected-path read/stat warnings could be hidden.

callers.flow: AppHostOwnership gives lsof_pids to SecondaryFifoLedger and uses it to detect unknown holders before task-output deletion.
Cleanup invokes holder callback on exact attested dirs and leaves, rejects any PID set and propagates query failure.
Imports canonical AppHostOwnership/owned_lane; inherited cleanup and final worker check preserve failures before file removal.

root_cause_and_reachability.authority: No new process is adopted from an open-file result. Returned PID set informs rejection, not arbitrary signal authority. Existing ownership and stop implementations are AST unchanged.

correction_review: Actual argv is /usr/sbin/lsof -nP -t +w followed by caller-owned arguments. +w follows the suppression-implying -t; no current production caller appends a suppression option.
Exit1 retains every reported PID (including partial +D selection); duplicate PIDs coalesce safely. It is not universally reinterpreted as no matches.
Unsupported status, any non-whitespace diagnostic or malformed PID lines remain failure. Exit0 with no holder lines now fails closed instead of pretending successful empty enumeration.
Oversized stdout/stderr are rejected at65536/4096 encoded bytes. These are explicitly post-capture acceptance limits, not streaming/process-memory ceilings.
New native warnings may include unrelated paths. Error now uses closed non-path-bearing text; failure is retained, not swallowed or logged raw.
TimeoutExpired propagates. No retry, warning filtering, recursive deletion, app/game/protocol/privacy/Store behavior change.

red.meaning: Genuine pre-fix witness. Command oracle fails on actual -w -t vs required -t+w; empty-success and stdout-bound cases fail; raw-path guard has four failing warning subtests. Seven failures is not seven distinct failing methods.

independent_regression_reconciliation.execution_scope: Python unittest, mocked subprocess outputs and synthetic path strings only. Test import has no native process operations. This is source/control proof, not proof that canonical native queries were executed or every OS warning scenario occurred.
independent_regression_reconciliation.test_assertion_limits: Oversized stderr case rejects as RuntimeError but does not distinguish warning rejection from size-specific rejection. Source enforces explicit bound; do not call this a hard-RAM experiment.

verification_receipts.cleanup_method: Exact task-owned generated dirs; no Gradle clean daemon or global cache deletion. Unrelated processes excluded by PID/start identity and cycle ownership.
